president.title: A word from the president
president.body1: It is with great pleasure and pride that I welcome you to The Journey Association. Our mission is to create sustainable pathways for tourism, culture, and community development across Morocco. We believe that tourism is not just about visiting beautiful places—it's about creating meaningful connections, preserving our heritage, and empowering local communities.
president.body2: Together with our partners, clubs, and dedicated members, we are building bridges between cultures, protecting our natural and cultural treasures, and ensuring that the benefits of tourism reach every corner of our beloved Morocco. Your participation and support make all the difference in achieving our vision of a sustainable and prosperous future.
president.name: Dr. Aderahim Azrkan

aboutPage.heroSubtitle: Morocco's leading network of adventure and cultural clubs, dedicated to inspiring youth through exploration, community, and purpose.
aboutPage.whoWeAreParagraph1: The Journey Association (جمعية الرحلة) was founded with a simple belief: that every young Moroccan deserves the opportunity to discover their country, connect with its heritage, and grow through adventure.
aboutPage.whoWeAreParagraph2: We organize treks, cultural tours, sporting events, and community projects that bring people together across Morocco's cities, mountains, and deserts.
aboutPage.missionDesc: To inspire youth and communities through meaningful adventure, cultural discovery, and personal growth across Morocco's diverse landscapes.
aboutPage.communityDesc: A growing network of clubs, volunteers, and passionate explorers united by a love for Morocco's nature, history, and culture.
aboutPage.reachDesc: Operating across Morocco's major cities — from the Atlantic coast to the Sahara — with clubs in Rabat, Casablanca, Marrakech, Fes, and beyond.
aboutPage.valuesCardDesc: Respect for nature, inclusivity, cultural pride, and a commitment to making adventure accessible for every Moroccan.
aboutPage.ctaSubtitle: Become a member of one of our clubs and start exploring Morocco with like-minded adventurers.
